description:
This talk was given at Ansh Mehra’s Indore AI & UX Meetup. The agenda for this video is get you to improve your UX thinking using AI. It covers -

👉🏽 UX Psychology and Laws
👉🏽 AI Tools and Resources
👉🏽 ChatGPT & AI Guidelines

Learning about UX Psychology and Laws helps you design with empathy, understand the user's mindset, and ensure that your creations meet legal requirements. It's a recipe for building visually appealing, legally compliant, and user-friendly interfaces.

Top that with exploring AI Tools and Resources, which opens doors to efficiency, allowing you to automate repetitive tasks and make data-driven design decisions.
